cohort: Antenatal women attending an integrated counseling and testing center (ICTC) for HIV at a tertiary care hospital in Odisha, India between January 2009 and December 2012.
finding: The HIV seroprevalence among antenatal women was 0.53% and the MTCT rate was 14.29%.
mod_finding: All three HIV-positive children were delivered vaginally.
